verses.html: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song. God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song. God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.title: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song.

verses.html: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.text: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

verses.html: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.text: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.html: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.text: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

verses.html: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.text: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.html: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
verses.text: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

verses.html: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.text: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
